psychological_meaning: Daintree is a deep, muted teal that evokes feelings of tranquility, sophistication, and connection to nature. It suggests stability, reliability, and a sense of calm confidence. This color is often associated with wisdom, integrity, and a refined aesthetic.

real_world_examples.description: The lush greenery of the Daintree Rainforest inspires the color's name, reflecting its deep, natural hues.

real_world_examples.title: Elegant Home Office
